title: 📅 Teen snack & movie afternoons at Freeport Library - NewsBreak
text:
9 hours ago 📅 After-school snack & movie for teens at library
Teens ages 11–18 are invited to Freeport Community Library – Meeting Room for “Explore: Gourmet Matinee” .
On the first Friday of each month , you’ll:
Make a no-cook snack you can easily remake at home Watch a movie on the big screen in the Community Room Upcoming dates, all from 2:30–4:30pm :
Friday, October 2, 2026 Friday, November 6, 2026 Friday, December 4, 2026 Friday, January 8, 2027 Friday, February 5, 2027 This is part of the Explore after-school program series from RSU5 Community Programs , hosted at Freeport Community Library .
Most sessions are drop-in ; only certain programs that need transportation require sign-ups. For the latest details, visit the RSU5 Community Programs website or email Chris at cprecreation@rsu5.org .
